questions.question: Describe how rhythm metre and tempo are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.

points.text: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use rhythm metre and tempo. Explain the effect in each case.

points.text: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how rhythm metre and tempo are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use rhythm metre and tempo in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.

points.text: A practical application showing understanding of how rhythm metre and tempo can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: identify metre as simple or compound; name tempo using Italian terms; identify specific rhythmic devices (syncopation, hemiola, polyrhythm, augmentation); explain how rhythmic choices create character; use precise vocabulary from the AQA elements list.
